## [[unimasi]]

### 1. Project Purpose
Immersive corporate website + Studio Admin + backend engine untuk **UNIMASI Studio** — Animation & Motion Design Studio. Tujuan: mendorong penjualan jasa animasi (2D, 3D, motion graphics, digital visual assets & AI-assisted production) ke audien lokal dan global melalui pengalaman web premium berbasis interaksi, animasi GSAP + Three.js/WebGL, dan konten editorial berkualitas tinggi (non-hard-sell). Unified monolith (situs publik + Studio Admin `/admin` + Delivery API + AI Copilot + agentic loop) dalam satu aplikasi Next.js 16.

Kontak terverifikasi dari `unimasi-brand.png`: `www.unimasi.id`, `@unimasi`. Domain alternatif di kode: `unimasi.studio` (site.ts/email/Instagram) — selisih, `needs-confirmation`.

### 2. Architecture Pattern
**Monolithic unified app** (Next.js 16 App Router, Turbopack). Tiga lapis dalam satu repo: frontend public, Studio Admin, backend engine (Delivery API, AI Copilot, agentic loop). Server-Driven UI (SDUI) block system, content graph, publishing scheduler, NextAuth, Prisma 8 ORM over PostgreSQL 16. Bukan headless decoupled (termasuk Delivery API tapi dalam satu app, tidak terpisah seperti SegiaTech).

### 3. Technology Stack
| Layer | Tech | Version |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | Next.js (App Router, Turbopack) | 16 |
| UI library | React | 19 |
| ORM / DB | Prisma 8 (`@prisma/orm-postgres`) | PostgreSQL 16 |
| Auth | NextAuth v5 beta | — |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS | v3 |
| Motion / WebGL | GSAP, Three.js | 3.12 / 0.187 |
| Port (dev/start) | 3001 | — |

Font: `Montserrat` (heading), `Sans Serif Regular` (body). Palet: Bright Yellow `#FFD600`, Dark Blue `#0F3A79`, Pure White `#FFFFFF`.

### 4. Initial Structure Impression
Root berisi `src/`, `prisma/`, `public/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `next.config.mjs`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `package.json`, `.env`/`.env.example`/`.env.local`. `src/` dibagi: `app/`, `blocks/`, `components/`, `lib/`, `config/`, `data/`. Root juga ada `proxy.ts` (no `middleware.ts`) dan `auth.ts`.

### 5. Configuration / Package Files
- `package.json` — scripts (`dev -p 3001`, `build`, `start`, `typecheck`, `db:push`, `db:seed`, `dev:wp-sync`, `validate-seed`, `seo-audit`).
- `next.config.mjs` — `output: 'standalone'`, image formats avif/webp.
- `tailwind.config.ts` — brand tokens.
- `prisma/schema.prisma` (~37 model, sama dengan erfo).
- `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml` (Coolify-ready), `.env.example`.
- `src/proxy.ts`, `src/auth.ts`, `src/config/site.ts`, `src/config/navigation.ts`.
- `src/data/seed/*.json`.

### 6. Directory Structure
```
unimasi/
├── src/app/          # Next.js App Router: pages + API routes
├── src/blocks/       # SDUI block system
├── src/components/   # UI, sections, studio editors, webgl, motion
├── src/lib/          # ai, agent, auth, blocks, db, delivery, seo, security, publishing, webhooks, dll
├── src/config/       # site.ts, navigation.ts
├── src/data/         # static data + seed JSON
├── src/proxy.ts      # Next.js 16 proxy (NO middleware.ts)
├── src/auth.ts       # NextAuth
├── prisma/           # schema.prisma
├── scripts/          # seed.ts, dev/wp-sync.ts, validate-seed.ts, seo-audit.ts
├── public/           # static assets (termasih unimasi-brand.png)
├── docs/             # brand docs & audit reports
├── Dockerfile
├── docker-compose.yml
└── .env.example
```

### 7. High-Level Architecture
Sama dengan erfo: layered monolith dalam satu Next.js app — Presentation (app + components), SDUI block layer (blocks), Business logic (lib/*), Data access (lib/db/* + prisma), Cross-cutting (proxy.ts, auth.ts, lib/security/*).

Perbedaan dengan erfo: brand, palet, font, port (3001 vs 3002), dan kontak (`unimasi.id`/`@unimasi` vs `erfo.id`/`@erfo.id`). Kode struktur sama karena kedua-duanya berasal dari template unified yang sama.

### 8. Build, Execution and Test
- `npm run dev` → `next dev -p 3001` (http://localhost:3001).
- `npm run build` → `next build` (Turbopack, standalone).
- `npm run start` → `next start -p 3001`.
- `npm run typecheck` → `tsc --noEmit`.
- `npm run db:push` → `prisma db update`; `npm run db:seed` → `tsx scripts/seed.ts`.
- `npm run dev:wp-sync` → `tsx scripts/dev/wp-sync.ts` (WordPress dev sync, hanya NODE_ENV !== production).
- `npm run validate-seed` → seed validator; `npm run seo-audit` → `tsx scripts/seo-audit.ts`.
- Entry point: `src/app/layout.tsx` + `src/app/page.tsx`; API routes under `src/app/api/*`.

## Module Deep Dive
Sama dengan erfo (`prompts/shared/module_deep_dive.md`):

### `src/app/` — Router + API surface
Halaman publik (`/`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/insights`, dll.), Studio Admin (`/admin/*`), dan endpoint HTTP (`api/ai/*`, `api/agent/tools`, `api/auth/*`, `api/upload`, `api/mcp`, dll.). Terhubung ke `src/lib/*` dan `src/auth.ts`.

### `src/blocks/` — SDUI block system
Kontrak blok, registry, parser Zod, publication gate, manifest. 8 blok terdaftar di ontology.

### `src/lib/db/` — Data access
Prisma 8 data access untuk semua model (`prisma/schema.prisma`).

### `src/lib/ai/` + `src/lib/agent/` — AI Copilot & agentic loop
ReAct loop (max 10 iterasi), tool registry (scope read/draft/admin, tidak ada publish), key rotation, audit logger.

### `src/lib/seo/` — SEO engine
Analyzer, metadata, jsonld (`@graph`), indexing, indexnow, crawler, site-audit, GEO/robots.

### `src/lib/publishing/` + `src/lib/webhooks/` — Scheduler & revalidation
Publication gate, scheduler (tick 30s, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`), dispatch webhook.

### `src/lib/security/` — Security layer
Rate limit, XSS sanitize, SSRF guard, upload guard.

## Core Entities

## APIs
Sama dengan erfo: `/api/auth/*` (public), `/api/health` (public), `/api/vitals` (public), `/api/indexnow/key` (public), `/api/v1/delivery/*` (`x-site-key`, timingSafeEqual, cache s-maxage=3600), `/api/ai/*` (session, rate limit), `/api/agent/tools` (session), `/api/mcp` (session), `/api/upload` (session, rate limit 30/m), `/api/revalidate` (`x-revalidate-secret`), `/api/seo/*` (session).

Delivery API multi-tenant, production menolak placeholder key/<16 char → 401.

---

## Database
PostgreSQL 16 via Prisma 8. Schema: `prisma/schema.prisma`. Migrasi: `npm run db:push` / `npx prisma db migrate`. Seed idempotent via `scripts/seed.ts`.

---

## Deployment
`Dockerfile`: multi-stage, standalone, non-root, healthcheck `/api/health`, listen `0.0.0.0`. `docker-compose.yml`: Coolify-ready, `postgres:16-alpine`, `db-migrate` (`exclude_from_hc: true`), `app` (`depends_on` service_completed_successfully), volume bernama, tanpa `ports:`/`env_file:`, secret `:?`/`SERVICE_*`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` via `build.args` + `ARG/ENV`. Port: 3001. Domain via `SERVICE_FQDN_APP_<PORT>`.

---

## Security Check
Sama dengan erfo: rate limit ai/upload (fixed), auth mcp/agent/tools (ok), delivery api key (fixed), session cookie (fixed), upload guard (ok), SSRF (ok), XSS sanitize (ok), Zod validation (ok), `npm audit --omit=dev` (0 vuln), secret di repo (ok).

Tertunda: rate limit in-memory (per-instance), CSP header belum ketat.
